hook: Your map of the UAE has a piece of Oman inside it.
title: A UAE Village Inside Oman Inside the UAE
description:
Madha is an Omani enclave surrounded by the UAE, and inside Madha sits Nahwa, a village that belongs to the UAE. Borders really can nest inside borders. Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Geography #PlacesThatShouldntExist
